owner: Android 原生客户端适配（用户独立授权，非M0）

usage.config: 预计包名/用户/默认模式、每App follow/split/global/direct、两单DNS、手动规则更新；尚未作为产品配置生效
usage.gui: 计划Java原生安装App选择/搜索/批量/Start/Stop/状态；当前设置页仅诊断配置预览

verification.scope: Bionic C ifreq+TUN ABI and original shared Rust Go↔Rust protected cold owner symbols (prepare/stage/commit/stop)
Real original-Go product CGo link to Android authenticated Rust M4 RAW/TUN worker
Bionic C ABI + protected Rust cold ownership + 16KiB ELF and original-Go full product link
正式Go TLS认证/租约→Rust Normal/off→实际服务端TCP/UDP/Stop
正式WBD连接、系统DNS/路由Apply、App配置与恢复
Bionic 真实产品构建及16KiB装载与ISA加速
Wi-Fi热点USB转发/offload/蜂窝CLAT/切网与能耗

limitations: 旧Root探针 PASS 只证明隔离内核/能力；普通系统DNS/真实WBD服务器、生产内核路由与真热点尚无产品证据。
